blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — A day after their gold-medal hopes were shattered, Khy Progella and Sofiah Pagara found themselves back on the sand with one more chance to complete an already historic Asian Games debut. Refusing to go home empty-handed, the young University of Santo Tomas pair recovered from a slow start to stun China’s Cao Shuting and Dong Jie, 13-21, 23-21, 15-13, on Friday at Hekinan Ryokuchi Beach Court, delivering the Philippines’ first Asian Games beach volleyball medal.
